context: Ren and Aoi visit; Sho and Hina excited to see them.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、あおいさん、いらっしゃい！
lines.style: Bright, excited greeting with genuine warmth. Open attack on the first word. High energy throughout but not strained—the natural pitch of an eight-year-old who's genuinely pleased. Bouncy pace, clear enunciation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ひな、しょう、お久しぶり。元気？
lines.en: Hina, Sho—long time no see. How are you?
lines.style: Warm, gentle greeting. Soft opening. Conversational pace, slightly dreamlike. Genuine affection underneath. The tone of someone who remembers them well and is genuinely happy to see them. Slight warm lilt at the questions.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: はい、元気です。赤ちゃん、もうすぐ？
lines.en: Yes, doing well. The baby—coming soon?
lines.style: Small, polite voice. Thoughtful pause before the question. Quiet curiosity, not demanding. The careful attention of a six-year-old who's noticed something important and wants to understand. Respectful, genuine interest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、もうすぐ。ひなと、しょうの、いとこ、になる。
lines.en: Yes, very soon. You two are going to be cousins.
lines.style: Soft, pleased delivery. Slight lift of warmth when sharing the news. Measured pace. Looking at both children with real tenderness. Not performing—just honestly happy to include them in this moment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 皆で、また、家族、増えるな。
lines.en: The family keeps growing, doesn't it.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective tone. Slight pause before speaking, as if the thought just landed. Warm undercurrent but somewhat philosophical. Not loud—just noticing something good. Steady, genuine.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: やったー！ひな、お姉さん、もっと、頑張る！
lines.en: Yes! I'm going to try even harder to be a good big sister!
lines.style: Bright triumph in the voice. Quick, decisive attack. Strong commitment in the middle of the statement. High energy but sincere—not performative. The earnest determination of a child who means what she's saying.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくも、お兄ちゃん、する。
lines.en: I'm going to be a big brother too.
lines.style: Small, steady voice. Matter-of-fact declaration. Quiet conviction—he's made up his mind. No need to be loud about it. Gentle but solid underneath.
